title: Claim
description: Claim view: one execution attempt on one task. Never carries the proof (CLAIM-011). In an effective view a lapsed lease shows status expired, ended_at = expires_at and end_recorded_at null until the lapse is recorded (CLAIM-051).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier. Clients must not parse it.

execution_id.description: Server-issued execution ID; one per claim (CLAIM-003). The value to hand to external systems for fencing.

run_id.description: Yak-Run-Id of the claiming request, if any. No authority.

epoch.description: Task epoch of this claim; strictly increasing per task (CLAIM-003). A fencing token.

brief_revision.description: The task's brief revision when the claim was acquired.

lease_seconds.description: Lease granted by the latest claim or renewal.

end_recorded_at.description: When the end was recorded. null while active, and for a lapse that is not yet materialized.
